title: UK Chancellor Announces New Budget Measures to Help Families
subtitle: John Healey introduces energy support and tax changes as the economy faces global challenges.

summary.en: Chancellor John Healey has announced his first Budget, focusing on cost-of-living support for UK households. Millions of families will receive a one-off £100 payment to help with rising energy bills. This support is funded by an increase in taxes on the profits of large banks. The government also extended a temporary cut to fuel duty to help drivers. However, some tax thresholds remain frozen, and economic growth forecasts have been downgraded.
summary.zh: 財政大臣希利宣布了他上任後的首份預算案，重點在於為英國家庭提供生活成本支援。數百萬家庭將獲得一筆過一百英鎊的補助，以協助支付上漲的能源帳單。這項支援由提高大型銀行利潤稅來資助。政府也延長了針對駕駛人的臨時燃油稅減免措施。然而，部分稅收門檻維持凍結，且經濟成長預測遭到下調。

paragraphs.en: Chancellor John Healey has delivered his first Budget, introducing a series of measures designed to help families manage the rising cost of living. Speaking to a busy House of Commons, Mr. Healey described the current UK economy as being under pressure from "global economic storms," including high oil prices caused by conflict in the Middle East. He stated that his goal was to provide "breathing space" for households while navigating these difficult times.
paragraphs.zh: 財政大臣希利（John Healey）發表了他上任後的首份預算案，推出一系列旨在協助家庭應對生活成本上漲的措施。希利在繁忙的下議院發言時表示，英國目前的經濟正承受來自「全球經濟風暴」的壓力，包括中東衝突導致的高油價。他指出，他的目標是在這些艱難時期為家庭提供「喘息空間」。

paragraphs.en: One of the most significant announcements is a one-off £100 payment for millions of households. This "Household Energy Payment" will be given to people living in council tax bands A to D in England. According to BBC Business, the government plans to fund this support by increasing the tax on the profits of large banks from 3% to 6%. This tax increase will remain in place until April 2028. While the payment is intended to assist with energy bills, the government confirmed that people are free to spend the money on whatever they need.
paragraphs.zh: 其中一項最重要的公告是向數百萬家庭發放一筆過一百英鎊的補助。這項「家庭能源補助」將提供給居住在英格蘭地方稅等級 A 到 D 的民眾。根據英國廣播公司商業新聞（BBC Business）報導，政府計畫透過將大型銀行的利潤稅從百分之三提高到百分之六來資助這項支援。這項增稅措施將持續到二零二八年四月。雖然這筆款項旨在協助支付能源帳單，但政府證實民眾可以自由將這筆錢用於任何需要的用途。

paragraphs.en: Energy costs remain a major concern for many. To address this, the government plans to remove fixed daily gas standing charges in England, Scotland, and Wales. These are the fixed fees customers pay just to be connected to the gas supply, regardless of how much they use. By moving these costs onto the price of each unit of energy, the government hopes to help lower-energy users save money. However, BBC Business noted that this change may mean higher bills for those who use a large amount of gas, such as large families in bigger homes.
paragraphs.zh: 能源成本仍是許多人關注的主要問題。為了解決此問題，政府計畫取消英格蘭、蘇格蘭和威爾斯的固定每日天然氣基本費。這是客戶無論使用多少天然氣，僅為了維持連接供應而必須支付的固定費用。透過將這些成本轉嫁到每單位能源的價格上，政府希望協助能源用量較低的用戶節省開支。然而，BBC 商業新聞指出，這項改變可能意味著使用大量天然氣的用戶（例如居住在較大房屋的大家庭）帳單將會增加。

paragraphs.en: Drivers will also see some relief, as the government has decided to extend a 5p cut in fuel duty on petrol and diesel until July. This "temporary" cut, which was first introduced in 2022, was scheduled to end soon. Motor fuel prices have risen sharply in recent months, and the government hopes this extension will prevent further financial stress for those who rely on their vehicles for work and daily life.
paragraphs.zh: 駕駛人也將獲得一些緩解，因為政府已決定將汽油和柴油的燃油稅減免五便士的措施延長至七月。這項最初於二零二二年推出的「臨時」減稅措施原定於近期結束。近幾個月來車用燃料價格急劇上漲，政府希望此次延長能避免讓那些依賴車輛工作與日常生活的民眾面臨更大的財務壓力。

paragraphs.en: For businesses, the Chancellor announced changes to business rates—a tax on non-domestic properties. The point at which high street shops in England start paying these rates will increase from £12,000 to £18,000. This is expected to provide some help to smaller shops, though vape shops and adult gaming centers are excluded from this support. Additionally, the minimum wage will rise by 3.9% in April, providing a pay increase for many workers.
paragraphs.zh: 針對企業方面，財政大臣宣布調整商業稅率，即針對非住宅物業徵收的稅款。英格蘭地區商業街商店開始繳納這些稅款的門檻將從一萬二千英鎊提高到一萬八千英鎊。預計這將為小型商店提供一些幫助，不過電子煙商店和成人遊戲中心被排除在此項支援之外。此外，最低工資將於四月調升百分之三點九，為許多勞工增加薪資。

paragraphs.en: Despite these measures, the government faces criticism regarding the overall state of the economy. The Office for Budget Responsibility (OBR), which acts as an official watchdog for government spending, has lowered its growth forecast for next year to 1%. The OBR also warned that British households may not be much better off than they were before the Covid-19 pandemic, even a decade later. David Miles, the head of the OBR, described this long-term outlook as "pretty grim."
paragraphs.zh: 儘管採取了這些措施，政府在整體經濟狀況方面仍面臨批評。作為政府支出官方監督機構的預算責任辦公室（OBR）已將明年的經濟成長預測下調至百分之一。該辦公室也警告，即使十年過去，英國家庭的經濟狀況可能仍不會比新冠肺炎疫情前好多少。預算責任辦公室負責人邁爾斯（David Miles）形容這種長期展望「相當嚴峻」。

paragraphs.en: Opposition leaders have been quick to criticize the Chancellor's plan. Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch argued that the measures were "not bold enough." She claimed the government is currently "overspent, overborrowed, overtaxed and drowning in an out-of-control welfare system." The government also confirmed that major decisions regarding defense spending and welfare will be delayed until next year, as public finances remain very tight. The UK is currently set to spend £14 billion more on debt interest payments this year alone.
paragraphs.zh: 反對黨領袖迅速批評了財政大臣的計畫。保守黨領袖巴登諾克（Kemi Badenoch）主張這些措施「不夠大膽」。她聲稱政府目前「支出過度、借貸過度、稅收過度，且深陷於失控的福利制度之中」。政府也證實，由於公共財政依然非常吃緊，有關國防支出和福利的重大決策將延後至明年。英國今年僅在債務利息支付上就預計將多花費一百四十億英鎊。

paragraphs.en: There were also changes regarding personal savings. The government has decided to cancel a plan to reduce the annual amount people can save tax-free in cash Individual Savings Accounts (ISAs). Instead, they plan to create a new "Starter ISA" to encourage first-time investors. However, those with large amounts in savings or property rentals will face higher taxes from April 2027, as income tax thresholds remain frozen. This means that as people's wages rise, they may pay a larger percentage of their income in tax, a process often called "fiscal drag."
paragraphs.zh: 個人儲蓄方面也有所變動。政府已決定取消一項減少民眾每年可在現金個人儲蓄帳戶（ISA）中免稅儲蓄金額的計畫。相反地，他們計畫設立一個新的「新手個人儲蓄帳戶」，以鼓勵首次投資者。然而，由於所得稅門檻維持凍結，擁有大量儲蓄或房產租賃收入的人士將從二零二七年四月起面臨更高的稅負。這意味著隨著民眾薪資上漲，他們可能需要支付更高比例的所得稅，這種現象通常被稱為「財政拖累」。

paragraphs.en: As the UK moves forward, the Chancellor emphasized that the government must choose a careful path through global uncertainties. While the new measures offer immediate help, the combination of frozen tax thresholds and slow economic growth suggests that many households will continue to face financial challenges in the coming years. For now, the government is focusing on small, targeted steps to support the public while waiting for the global economic situation to stabilize.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著英國向前邁進，財政大臣強調政府必須在全球不確定性中謹慎選擇前進道路。雖然新措施提供了即時的幫助，但凍結稅收門檻與緩慢的經濟成長相結合，顯示許多家庭在未來幾年將持續面臨財務挑戰。目前，政府正專注於採取小規模、有針對性的步驟來支援大眾，同時等待全球經濟局勢穩定。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A period of time or a situation that allows someone to relax or recover from pressure.
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面意思為呼吸的空間，這裡比喻在經濟壓力下獲得的緩解機會。文中：He stated that his goal was to provide "breathing space" for households while navigating these difficult times.

keyTerms.definitionEn: In a more favorable or improved financial situation.
keyTerms.noteZh: 容易誤以為是「更好」的比較級，但在這裡專指財務狀況的改善。文中：The OBR also warned that British households may not be much better off than they were before the Covid-19 pandemic, even a decade later.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Limited or restricted, especially regarding money or resources.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作形容物體「緊的」，這裡形容公共財政資源有限。文中：The government also confirmed that major decisions regarding defense spending and welfare will be delayed until next year, as public finances remain very tight.

quiz.question: Which of the following is true regarding the changes to gas charges mentioned in the article?

options.A: All households in the UK will see a reduction in their total gas bills.
options.B: The fixed daily fee for gas connection will be removed in England, Scotland, and Wales.
options.C: The government is increasing the cost of each unit of gas to pay for bank taxes.
options.D: Large families will benefit the most from the removal of fixed daily charges.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，政府計劃取消英國、蘇格蘭和威爾斯的固定每日燃氣連接費（standing charges）。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章提到這可能會導致高用量用戶的帳單增加；選項 C 錯誤，銀行稅是用來資助 100 英鎊的家庭能源補助，而非取消固定費用的資金來源；選項 D 錯誤，文章明確指出高用量用戶（如大家庭）反而可能面臨更高的帳單。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the impact of 'fiscal drag' on the average UK worker?

options.A: It will provide workers with more disposable income to spend on luxury goods.
options.B: It encourages workers to save more money in their Individual Savings Accounts (ISAs).
options.C: It effectively increases the tax burden on individuals as their earnings increase over time.
options.D: It forces the government to lower tax thresholds to keep up with inflation.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第八段，當工資上升但稅收門檻（tax thresholds）保持不變時，人們會支付更大比例的收入作為稅款，這就是所謂的「財政拖累」（fiscal drag）。選項 A 與事實相反，因為稅負增加會減少可支配收入；選項 B 錯誤，文章提到的是 ISA 的變化，而非財政拖累帶來的鼓勵；選項 D 錯誤，文章指出門檻是被「凍結」而非調降以適應通膨。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the phrase 'choose a careful path' most likely mean?

options.A: To select a physical route for government officials to travel.
options.B: To adopt a cautious and measured approach to economic policy.
options.C: To ignore the global economic storms and focus on local issues.
options.D: To change the direction of the UK's defense spending strategy.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在文末語境中，「choose a careful path」是一種隱喻，意指政府在面對全球經濟不確定性時，必須採取審慎、謹慎的決策方式。選項 A 將其誤解為字面上的「路徑」；選項 C 與文章強調政府需應對全球經濟壓力相矛盾；選項 D 雖然提到國防支出，但並非此片語在文中的主要含義。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article regarding the Chancellor's new Budget?

options.A: The Budget will fully solve the UK's long-term economic problems and boost growth.
options.B: The Chancellor is prioritizing tax cuts for large banks over family support.
options.C: The government is implementing targeted, short-term measures while facing a difficult long-term economic outlook.
options.D: The opposition party has successfully blocked most of the Chancellor's proposed economic reforms.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章整體結構先介紹了針對家庭與企業的短期紓困措施（如 100 英鎊補助、燃料稅減免），隨後引用 OBR 的警告與反對黨的批評，指出長期經濟前景依然嚴峻，政府正採取謹慎的策略。選項 A 過於樂觀，與文中提到的「grim」前景不符；選項 B 錯誤，銀行稅是為了資助家庭補助；選項 D 錯誤，文中僅提到反對黨「批評」，並未提到法案被阻擋。
